Government_Organization: Canadian Space Agency / Agence spatiale canadienne
Description: PAT is intended to support operators’ space robotics training by creating a state-of-the-art learning experience that includes both theoretical knowledge and practical application. Familiarization with the Mobile Servicing System (MSS, aka Canadarm2) and its robotics work station (RWS) operational environment is the first lesson new recruits receive when taking the robotics training at CSA. Under this initiative, PAT will provide this familiarization training, first for the MSS currently on the International Space Station, and eventually for the Gateway External Robotics System (Canadarm3) located on the new Gateway Station orbiting the Moon. The goal is to provide a comprehensive learning experience for CSA personnel, ensuring they are well equipped to handle current and future space missions. This project aims to set a new benchmark for adaptive learning within the CSA by integrating AI to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.
Reported_Results: PAT will significantly increase the effectiveness of the training programs by reducing the costs for one-on-one instruction, trainee travel, and trainee and instructor logistics. This has the potential to reduce costs significantly for CSA’s modern space missions and operations involving the Canadarm technology. PAT can be extended to other lessons and other training applications and can be used to complement existing training delivery methods.
